description: This file is a Python script that interacts with GitHub's GraphQL API to fetch discussions from a specific repository, processes discussion comments and replies to identify expert contributors, and generates a YAML data file with maintainers and experts information, optionally creating a pull request to update this data in the repository.

classes.name: Author
classes.description: Represents a GitHub user with login, avatar URL, and profile URL.

classes.name: CommentsNode
classes.description: Base model for comment nodes with creation date and author.

classes.name: Replies
classes.description: Holds total count and list of reply comment nodes.

classes.name: DiscussionsComments
classes.description: Holds total comment count and list of discussion comment nodes.

classes.name: DiscussionsNode
classes.description: Represents a discussion, including number, author, title, creation date, and comments.

classes.name: DiscussionsEdge
classes.description: GraphQL edge containing cursor and discussion node.

classes.name: Discussions
classes.description: Contains a list of discussion edges.

classes.name: DiscussionsResponseData
classes.description: Wrapper for discussions data in API response.

classes.name: DiscussionsResponse
classes.description: Top-level model for GraphQL discussions API response.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Configuration model with GitHub token, repository, and timeout settings.

classes.name: DiscussionExpertsResults
classes.description: Data class aggregating counters of commenters over various periods and authors mapping.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] get_graphql_response( *, settings: Settings, query: str, after: Union[str, None] = None, category_id: Union[str, None] = None, )
methods.description: Executes a GraphQL request to GitHub API with provided query and variables, returning the parsed JSON data.

methods.name: list[DiscussionsEdge] get_graphql_question_discussion_edges( *, settings: Settings, after: Union[str, None] = None, )
methods.description: Fetches discussion edges from the GitHub repository using GraphQL, filtered by category.

methods.name: list[DiscussionsNode] get_discussion_nodes(settings: Settings)
methods.description: Aggregates discussion nodes from multiple pages via pagination.

methods.name: DiscussionExpertsResults get_discussions_experts( discussion_nodes: list[DiscussionsNode], )
methods.description: Analyzes discussion comments and replies to identify commenters over different time frames.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] get_top_users( *, counter: Counter[str], authors: dict[str, Author], skip_users: Container[str], min_count: int = 2, )
methods.description: Selects top commenters above a minimum count, excluding specified users.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] get_users_to_write( *, counter: Counter[str], authors: dict[str, Author], min_count: int = 2, )
methods.description: Prepares a list of users with counts and author data, filtering by minimum comment count.

methods.name: bool update_content(*, content_path: Path, new_content: Any)
methods.description: Writes new data to a YAML file if it differs from existing content.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Main execution function that orchestrates fetching discussions, processing commenters, generating data, and optionally creating a PR.
